_snapshotData.name: Costco Wholesale Corporation
_snapshotData.description: Costco Wholesale Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of membership warehouses in the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the United Kingdom, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Iceland, New Zealand, and Sweden. It offers merchandise, including sundries, dry groceries, candies, coolers, freezers, deli, liquor, and tobacco; non-food merchandise comprising appliances, small electronics, health and beauty aids, hardware, lawn and garden, sporting goods, tires, toys and seasonal, automotive, stamps, tickets, apparel, furniture, domestics, housewares, special order kiosks, and jewelry; and fresh food, such as meat, produce, service deli, and bakery products. The company is also involved in warehouse ancillary operations, which include gasoline, pharmacies, optical, food courts, hearing-aid centers, and tire installation centers. In addition, it engages in e-commerce, business centers, travel, and other businesses. The company was formerly known as Costco Companies, Inc. and changed its name to Costco Wholesale Corporation in August 1999. Costco Wholesale Corporation was founded in 1976 and is based in Issaquah, Washington.

moatAnalysis.moat_narrative: Costco Wholesale Corporation possesses a none economic moat (score: 38/100). Strongest advantages: Supply-Side Economies (moderate) and Switching Costs (weak). Costco Wholesale Corporation shows moderate supply-side economies of scale.

supply_side.explanation: Costco Wholesale Corporation shows moderate supply-side economies of scale. Revenue growing at 21.5% with earnings growing at 45.5% — positive 24.0% operating leverage. moderate gross margins of 12.9% and operating margins of 3.7% at at massive scale.

network_effects.explanation: Costco Wholesale Corporation has limited demand-side economies of scale. Discount Stores suggests limited network potential. Financial trends do not strongly indicate network effects. Awaiting user product-level assessment.

learning_curve.explanation: Costco Wholesale Corporation has weak learning curve advantages. Discount Stores has limited knowledge barriers. Historical margin data confirms sustained high margins.

switching_costs.explanation: Costco Wholesale Corporation benefits from weak switching costs. Discount Stores offers relatively easy substitution.  YoY revenue growth of 21.5% indicates strong customer retention.

aiDisruption.threat_analysis: Discount Stores has limited AI disruption risk. Physical infrastructure, regulatory moats, and tangible assets provide insulation.
aiDisruption.opportunity_analysis: AI offers limited transformative potential for Discount Stores. Benefits are primarily operational efficiency gains.
aiDisruption.net_assessment: Costco Wholesale Corporation faces a neutral from AI. AI creates both challenges and opportunities that roughly balance.
